output.summary: The decline is mostly explained by the temporary Brightwater venue and a regional downturn, not by programming. Single-ticket sales dropped sharply when the venue changed (E4). The cathedral, which is downtown, sold far more tickets with similar programs (E11). Lapsed patrons mostly cite travel (E12). Concerts with post-1945 works sell the same as those without (E7). Core subscribers still renew at about 85% (E5). Peers lost a similar share of revenue without moving venue (E10). Marketing effectiveness is untested because attribution data does not exist. Non-renewal would trigger the key-person grant lapse and punish the wrong cause. Recommended: a segmented analysis for the board, use the cathedral dates and a shuttle, and keep programming and the artistic review separate.
